subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should shared plain-text repair execute standalone JSON tool-call objects across Ollama, LM Studio, and xAI, or should the canonical report remain a native Ollama routing/conversion fix?
rationale: The broader fallback changes cross-provider execution semantics, while the linked report may be explained by the unsupported `/v1` route and current Ollama code already supports native structured calls.

options.title: Keep native routing canonical
options.body: Verify or repair native Ollama `tool_calls`, then require a separate live content-only reproduction before expanding shared repair.

options.title: Adopt shared JSON execution
options.body: Approve the broader fallback only after narrowing sanitization and proving live behavior on each intended provider class.

recommendation.title: Keep native routing canonical
recommendation.body: Verify or repair native Ollama `tool_calls`, then require a separate live content-only reproduction before expanding shared repair.
